messages:
Maya (eng-release): kicking off release corridor sync for the API+runtime+console+router change window at 22:00 UTC. please confirm owners for any incompatible config or header changes.
Sam (runtime): i have a kernel-selection tweak that changes default kv-ttl handling (minor). runtime image will be v2.14.3. needs a short rollout window and a canary of 1% traffic.
Kevin (console): console UI has a small schema bump for route metadata (adds 'origin_service'). UI can handle old payloads but will log warnings. console build -> v3.2.0.
Jordan (router): router will add opt-in header X-Redwood-Orig for tracing; routing rules unchanged. requires header passthrough in API gateway.
Maya (eng-release): thumbs. Sam/Kevin/Jordan do we have pinned model versions or feature flags to toggle if we need to hedge? list them here.
Sam (runtime): runtime flag `runtime.kv_ttl_compat` default=true, can flip to false if we need strict behavior. model pin: none for this rollout.
Kevin (console): console flag `ui.metadata_strict` default=false. we can flip on if warnings spike.
Jordan (router): no model pins. I'll add a temporary header toggle at the router level: `router.headers.x-redwood-orig: enabled` that we can flip per-region.
OpsSRE: deploy-bot preflight run started. tagging owners. please attach minimal rollback criteria.
Maya (eng-release): rollback criteria (proposal): 1) error rate > 2% for 5m across servo endpoints, 2) tail latency p95 increase > 300ms for 10m, 3) console error surge > 4xx spike 3x baseline. if any hit, we pin back runtime to v2.14.2 and flip flags.
Sam (runtime): noted. For rollback, runtime config will revert to `runtime.kv_ttl_compat=true` and image -> v2.14.2. I'll prepare an automated rollback playbook.
Kevin (console): console rollback: promote v3.1.8, enable `ui.metadata_strict=false`. I'll stage the artifact in canary group.
Jordan (router): router rollback = toggle `router.headers.x-redwood-orig: disabled` and remove header injection.
release-bot: preflight checks: image scans OK, infra quota OK, db migrations: none detected, canary target set to 1%. CI: 12/12 green.
Maya (eng-release): good. windows: quiet window opens 21:50 UTC, deploy starts 22:00, canary 22:05 for 10m, ramp to 25% at 22:20, full at 22:40. sound good?
OpsSRE: confirm. making ops channel #release-2024-11-06. will monitor dashboards and post alerts there.
Sam (runtime): quick note: the kernel tweak changes default memory footprint by ~120MB per pod. please validate node autoscaler headroom.
Kevin (console): console memory unchanged.
Jordan (router): router infra fine, but need to bump ephemeral connection limit in gateway by +1000 for the first 30m of ramp.
Maya (eng-release): action items: Sam bump node headroom and post in thread when done; Jordan update gateway flag; Kevin stage console rollback artifact; OpsSRE create alert runbook. I'll update release note snippet.
Sam (runtime): done — node headroom bumped in staging and prod queue, posted autoscaler PR: https://git.internal/runtime/PR-489.
Jordan (router): gateway flag updated, patch rolled to edge gate: `gateway.max_ephemeral += 1000`.
Kevin (console): rollback artifact staged at s3://releases/console/v3.1.8.
OpsSRE: runbook created and linked: https://runbooks/internal/release-corridor-2024-11-06. monitoring dashboards pinned.
Maya (eng-release): final check before quiet window: anyone have objections? else we'll flip the deploy bot at 21:58.
Sam (runtime): no objections. :thumbsup:
Kevin (console): fine from my side. :+1:
Jordan (router): good here.
release-bot: scheduled deploy at 1712402280 (22:00 UTC) — will post live updates to #release-ops.
Maya (eng-release): thanks all — i'll post release note summary to the release channel and close this thread.
OpsSRE: copy that. monitoring handoff at 21:55.
Maya (eng-release): closing thread, moving to ops channel. :rocket:
